blocks.text: Langley condos and townhomes by price band, September 2026

128 condos and townhomes sold in September against 699 listed. The price band with the most sales was $500,001 to $600,000, with 25 sold (20% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $700,001 to $800,000 at 22%.

blocks.text: Condo buildings in Langley Condos for Sale
Streets, schools and getting around Langley Condos for Sale

items.t: Scope: the board/SnapStats community "Langley," combining the Township and the City across eleven sub-areas: Aldergrove, Brookswood, Campbell Valley, County Line Glen Valley, Fort Langley, Langley City, Murrayville, Otter District, Salmon River, Walnut Grove and Willoughby Heights.

Community context: Langley Condos & Townhomes median $611,000, $513/sq ft, 97% sale-to-list, 25 days; detached median $1,345,000. There is NO condo-only split in SnapStats — condo-only figures are UNVERIFIED.

Sub-area attached context (active / sold / sales ratio, September 2026): Willoughby Heights 369 / 70 / 19%; Langley City 195 / 34 / 17%; Walnut Grove 55 / 10 / 18%; Murrayville 35 / 8 / 23% (highest attached ratio, small base); Aldergrove 30 / 5 / 17%; Fort Langley 9 / 1 / 11% (small-count caution). SnapStats publishes medians at community level only — per-sub-area medians are UNVERIFIED.

Feed evidence at reading: two active cards in full, both in the Langley City sub-area (53a Avenue, described in its listing text as a 55+ community; Eastleigh Crescent, built 2020 per its listing text) — listing copy only. The feed's total size and exact filter criteria are UNVERIFIED.
Catchment for any specific condo address: UNVERIFIED — no SD35 locator run for a condo building address is on record.

SkyTrain: the Surrey Langley SkyTrain extension ends at Langley City Centre station; the Province states all eight stations along the 16-kilometre extension are under construction, with operation expected in late 2029. Bus route numbers/frequencies and Carvolth Exchange service levels: UNVERIFIED — no TransLink timetable was opened in the research pass.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Langley Condos for Sale

items.t: Two municipalities, two rule sets: City of Langley Zoning Bylaw 2025 No. 3300 governs the City buildings — cite the number; its adoption date is UNVERIFIED (conflicted in sources). City suite cap: the lesser of 100 m² and 40% of gross floor area, registered owner must reside on the lot; City SSMUH Bylaw No. 3284, adopted June 17, 2024 (RS1/RS2: 4 units, or 6 within 400 m of a frequent bus stop). Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 2500 governs the Township buildings; Township SSMUH Bylaw No. 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024) has NO 6-plex tier — 3 units on lots of 280 m² or less, 4 units on lots between 280 m² and 4,050 m² — and the Township suite cap is 120 m². Township gentle-density context only; it does not change an existing strata building's bylaws.

blocks.text: Good to know about Langley Condos for Sale

items.t: The feed page's own research verified zero buildings.

Two Willoughby names are not finished resale stock: Matteo is under construction in listings and Walnut Park's completion status is UNCONFIRMED — counting them as available resale condos counts presales.

The combined median is at its 13-month low and still is not a condo price: the Condos & Townhomes median ranged from $611,000 (September 2026, the window low) to $725,000 (June 2026) across September 2025–September 2026 — a blended attached figure in every month.

Willoughby's Community Plan has a new frame to check: the Willoughby Community Plan was Bylaw 1836 (1979) and is now Schedule 6 to Bylaw 6200 (adopted December 1, 2025); the Willoughby Plan Update Bylaws 6201/6202/6203 had first/second reading May 25, 2026 ONLY — never describe them as adopted or as having replaced the plan.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Langley Condos for Sale
What Langley land means in this topic's frame

items.t: Fee-simple lots — the default form for Langley land: A coach house is not a townhouse complex and is counted nowhere as one.

The R-CL small-lot frame (Township, rule level): Township Zoning Bylaw 2500 s.403 (R-CL) sets 220 m² minimum / 464.5 m² maximum lot area — there is no 355 m² figure in the bylaw; any source stating a 355 m² R-CL cap is wrong. That is a zoning-frame fact about Township small lots, not an inventory of lots for sale.
ALR vs non-ALR split

Assemblies / proposals — documented as such, never as inventory: The Surrey Langley SkyTrain extension (all eight stations under construction, operation expected late 2029) is infrastructure under construction, not a lot offering.

items.t: What the page covers: a housing-form feed page, not an area page — headed "Langley Condos for Sale | MLS® Listings," carrying editorial copy organized by condo district (Willoughby/Latimer/Carvolth, Walnut Grove, Murrayville, Langley City) above a live MLS® feed of condo listings: a condo-only MLS® filter laid over all of Langley (Township of Langley plus the separate City of Langley).

Board identity: Langley is a Fraser Valley Real Estate Board (FVREB) community in the SnapStats data, with 11 sub-areas; the Condos & Townhomes sub-area rows most relevant to this feed are Willoughby Heights, Langley City, Walnut Grove and Murrayville — as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report.

SkyTrain (Surrey Langley SkyTrain): the extension will end at Langley City Centre station; the Province's project reporting states all eight stations along the 16-kilometre extension are under construction, with the extension expected to enter operation in late 2029, extending the Expo Line from King George Station in Surrey to Langley City Centre. blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Langley Condos for Sale

items.t: TOWNSHIP — plans + zoning: Zoning Bylaw 2500. The Willoughby Community Plan was Bylaw 1836 and is now Schedule 6 to Bylaw 6200 (adopted December 1, 2025); the Willoughby Plan Update Bylaws 6201/6202/6203 had first/second reading May 25, 2026 ONLY — never describe them as adopted or as having replaced the plan.

TOWNSHIP — SSMUH: implemented through Zoning Bylaw No. 2500 Amendment Bylaw No. A page or research claim of a Township 6-plex tier is WRONG. Township suite cap 120 m². Township coach house = fee-simple s.102 unit under Bylaw 2500, never strata.
TOWNSHIP — R-CL small lots: Zoning Bylaw 2500 s.403 (R-CL) = 220 m² minimum / 464.5 m² maximum lot area (no 355 m² figure).

CITY — zoning + SSMUH: City of Langley Zoning Bylaw 3300 by number — cite the number; its adoption date is UNVERIFIED (conflicted in sources). City suite cap = the lesser of 100 m² and 40% of gross floor area, with the registered owner required to reside on the lot.

Strata diligence (the BC strata block — applies to the 22 buildings' strata lots and in full to any bare-land strata lot): Form B diligence (fees, amounts owed, levies, CRF balance, insurance summary; provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page) — read it with the depreciation report, contingency reserve and any special levies before pricing an offer; depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022 (short-term restrictions may still apply by bylaw); only 55+ age bylaws valid under Strata Property Act ss. 123.1/123.2, with May 1, 2023 exemptions (younger spouse/partner, caregivers, legacy residents, defined children); a listing's "45+" line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw.

ALR rules (carried for any Township parcel where reserve status is confirmed — no parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within the principal residence only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha).

items.t: September 2026's combined attached median was the 13-month low: $611,000, against a range up to $725,000 (June 2026) across September 2025 – September 2026 — and it is a blended condos-plus-townhomes figure in any case, never a condo median and never a land figure. Willoughby alone is over half the attached shelf: 369 of 699 combined attached listings (about 53%) sit in one Township sub-area — Langley-wide attached averages are Willoughby averages in disguise. As of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report.
Small-count reading, not a demand verdict. As of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report.

The two Langleys meet at one SkyTrain station corner: Willowbrook station, at the northeast corner of 196 Street and Fraser Highway, will serve Surrey, the Township and the City, which meet at that spot — a building's municipality there decides which zoning bylaw, suite cap and SSMUH tier applies to its lot, metres apart.

faq.q: Which part of Langley has the most condos listed?
faq.a: By the combined Condos & Townhomes sub-area rows, Willoughby Heights holds by far the largest attached inventory — 369 of Langley's 699 listings in September 2026, with 70 solds — followed by Langley City at 195 listings and 34 solds (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats). The live page's editorial agrees in substance: Willoughby, Latimer and Carvolth are "where much of the new condo building in the Township has happened".
The Surrey Langley SkyTrain extension ends at Langley City Centre station; all eight stations are under construction and the Province expects the extension to enter operation in late 2029.

faq.q: What should I check before buying a Langley condo?
faq.a: The strata bylaws, the depreciation report, recent strata minutes, the Form B information certificate and the contingency reserve fund — the checklist the live page itself gives — plus, on newer buildings, the exact home-warranty position confirmed from the building's documents.

faq.q: Are Langley City and the Township of Langley the same market?
faq.a: No — they are two separate municipalities, and the feed covers both. In the September 2026 combined attached rows, Langley City (as a sub-area) showed 195 listings and 34 solds at a 17% sales ratio, while the Township's largest attached sub-area, Willoughby Heights, showed 369 listings and 70 solds at 19% (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats).

faq.q: What is the median price of a Langley condo?
faq.a: There is no published condo-only median.

faq.q: Are Langley City and the Township the same market?
faq.a: No — two separate municipalities with separate bylaws and tax notices, and the feed covers both.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Langley condo long-term?
faq.a: Yes in law: every BC strata rental-restriction bylaw has been void since November 24, 2022, including the directory "rentals not allowed" lines for Parkway Estates and Parkway II. Short-term rentals can still be restricted, and a tenant in a 55+ building must still satisfy the age bylaw or an exemption.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Langley condo?
faq.a: Catchment assignment for a specific condo address is UNVERIFIED — no locator run for a condo address is on record, so run the exact address in the SD35 locator before relying on a school claim.

faq.q: What is the median price of a Langley townhouse?
faq.a: No townhome-only median exists — SnapStats publishes only Detached and Condos & Townhomes combined ($611,000, Sep 2026).

faq.q: City or Township — does it change my rules?
faq.a: Yes — separate bylaws/taxes: City Zoning 2025 No.
